entries.title: Psalms 84:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> How amiable [are] thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts! {for the sons: or, of the sons}

words.text: ! {for the sons: or, of the sons}

entries.title: Psalms 84:2
segments: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

entries.title: Psalms 84:3
segments: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, [even] thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

words.text: for herself, where she may lay

entries.title: Psalms 84:4
segments: Blessed [are] they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 84:5
segments: Blessed [is] the man whose strength [is] in thee; in whose heart [are] the ways [of them].

entries.title: Psalms 84:6
segments: [Who] passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools. {Baca...: or, mulberry trees make him a well, etc} {filleth: Heb. covereth}

words.text: . {Baca...: or, mulberry trees make him a well, etc} {filleth: Heb. covereth}

entries.title: Psalms 84:7
segments: They go from strength to strength, [every one of them] in Zion appeareth before God. {strength to...: or, company to company}

entries.title: Psalms 84:8
segments: ¶O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 84:9
segments: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 84:10
segments: For a day in thy courts [is] better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness. {I had...: Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold}

words.text: . {I had...: Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold}

entries.title: Psalms 84:11
segments: For the LORD God [is] a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good [thing] will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 84:12
segments: O LORD of hosts, blessed [is] the man that trusteth in thee.
